newsitem.title: DUBAI: Italian tourist kidnapped by tribesmen in Yemen.
newsitem.headline: Italian tourist kidnapped by tribesmen in Yemen.

text.p: Yemeni tribesmen have kidnapped an Italian tourist, an Italian diplomat in Sanaa said on Thursday.
"I confirm that an Italian tourist has been kidnapped," the diplomat said by telephone from Sanaa, but he gave no details.
Yemeni sources said the tourist was kidnapped on Wednesday.
"We are waiting for news," the diplomat said.

Kidnapping of foreigners in the poor state at the southern end of the Arabian peninsula is a common ploy by tribesmen holding grievances against the government or foreign oil firms operating in the country.
Late last month Yemeni tribesmen kidnapped two Italian tourists near the capital Sanaa and released them a day later.
